title: A box with your name on it
text: A stranger leaves a sealed box at the orphanage, addressed to {player.givenName} in a hand nobody recognises.

choices.label: Open it
choices.text: Whatever it is, it is yours.

effects.text: Inside: a faded wanted poster, a compass that points nowhere useful, and a name you have never heard.

choices.label: Keep it sealed
choices.text: Some things are better not known. Yet.

effects.text: You hide the box under a floorboard and try not to think about it.

choices.label: Sell it unopened
choices.text: A collector in the harbour buys strange things.

effects.text: A collector pays well for the box and asks no questions. You wonder about it anyway.
